caption: The drawing depicts a partially faded, sketched figure centered in the composition, rendered primarily in black lines against a brownish-beige background. The figure appears to be standing and is shown with arms raised, holding objects resembling leafy branches in both hands. The upper part of the figure’s head is faintly outlined, with a defined beard and facial features, while a draped garment is indicated by dark lines suggesting folds. A large, arching shape in a lighter brown tone surrounds the figure, with two dark reddish-brown areas near the top left and right corners of the arch. The upper border contains a row of stylized, floral or vegetative shapes in red and black. Some areas of the drawing are heavily worn or eroded, especially across the central portion of the figure, resulting in missing or fragmented details. The overall palette is muted, consisting of earth tones such as tan, reddish-brown, black, and off-white.
title: Wall Decoration
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
